types.name: caldav
types.title: A CalDAV calendar (RFC 6638) with an app password
types.description: A CalDAV calendar (RFC 6638) with an app password — your events on Today, and replies to invitations from Metistry. For iCloud or Fastmail, use their own entries.

types.name: devin
types.title: Devin (Cognition)
types.description: Devin (Cognition) — send a task to a Devin session; its structured answer comes back as a report. Its knowledge notes and repo wikis come into the inbox. A cog_ key, sent to api.devin.ai and mcp.devin.ai only.

fields.label: Organization
fields.help: The org-… id a session is charged to. Required: a session is a spend, and which organization pays is not inferred.

fields.label: Repository wikis
fields.help: owner/repo, comma-separated — the repos whose Devin wikis devin-knowledge reads. Empty: knowledge notes only.

types.name: fastmail-calendar
types.title: Fastmail Calendar over CalDAV with an app password
types.description: Fastmail Calendar over CalDAV with an app password — your events on Today, and replies to invitations from Metistry.

types.name: github
types.title: GitHub
types.description: GitHub — the issues and pull requests of the repositories you name, on the Board as work, with a request for each review asked of you and each issue assigned to you. A read-only token, sent to api.github.com only.

fields.label: Repositories
fields.help: owner/repo, comma-separated — the repositories reconciled into work.

types.name: github-issues
types.title: GitHub Issues
types.description: GitHub Issues — a task sent here opens an issue in one repository; closing the issue closes the task. A fine-grained write token for that repository, sent to api.github.com only.

fields.label: Repository
fields.help: owner/repo — the one repository issues are opened in. The github sync must read it too, so the issue's status comes home.

types.name: gmail-mail
types.title: Gmail over IMAP with an app password (2-Step Verification on)
types.description: Gmail over IMAP with an app password (2-Step Verification on) — who wrote and about what (headers, never bodies), and drafts you send yourself. Nothing sends mail.

types.name: google-calendar
types.title: Google Calendar, signed in with Google
types.description: Google Calendar, signed in with Google — your events on Today, replies to invitations and changes to your own events from Metistry. Metistry's sign-in client, or your own.

fields.label: Sign in with Google
fields.help: Google hasn't verified this app yet. Google will say "Google hasn't verified this app" — choose Advanced, then Go to Metistry, to continue. Metistry asks only to see and change your calendar events, and your sign-in goes straight from Google to this Mac.

types.name: icloud-calendar
types.title: iCloud Calendar over CalDAV with an app-specific password
types.description: iCloud Calendar over CalDAV with an app-specific password — your events on Today, and replies to invitations from Metistry.

fields.label: Server
fields.help: Where discovery starts. iCloud may name a numbered host (p<NN>-caldav.icloud.com) for your account; the connection then points there.

types.name: ics
types.title: An iCalendar feed (.ics)
types.description: An iCalendar feed (.ics) — a published calendar's events, read-only, on Today with every other calendar. Public feed addresses only in this release.

types.name: imap
types.title: A mailbox over IMAP with an app password
types.description: A mailbox over IMAP with an app password — who wrote and about what (headers, never bodies), and drafts you send yourself. Nothing sends mail. For Gmail, use its own entry.

types.name: linear
types.title: Linear
types.description: Linear — the issues assigned to you, on the Board as work and in Needs You as tasks. A personal API key, sent to api.linear.app only.
